name: Kanematsu Corporation
summary: Kanematsu Corporation trades in commercial products in Japan and internationally. It operates through Electronics and Devices; Foods, Meat and Grain; Steel; Materials and Plants; and Motor Vehicles and Aerospace segments. The company offers semiconductor equipment, components and materials, industrial electronics, semiconductors and devices, mobile, as well as data, AI, and SaaS.
